Thanks for following up, and sorry for the wait on a reply.

Order Shop····, the Magic Miner 40T with the Miner Duster and Power Kit, ships October 31. Our emails have been landing in junk for some customers, so it is worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts. You can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
